name: magnet-menu-radix
title: Magnet Menu (Radix)
description: A navigation menu whose hover highlight slides from link to link, and an underline that marks the current page, both placed with CSS anchor positioning.
author: Jhey <https://codepen.io/jh3y>
docs:
Installed `MagnetMenu` and `MagnetMenuLink` in `components/ui/` (with its fallback script and stylesheet next to them), plus the `compose-refs` helper in `lib/`.

```tsx
import { MagnetMenu, MagnetMenuLink } from "@/components/ui/magnet-menu";

<MagnetMenu aria-label="Sections">
  <MagnetMenuLink href="/" active>Home</MagnetMenuLink>
  <MagnetMenuLink href="/craft">Craft</MagnetMenuLink>
</MagnetMenu>
```

The highlight follows the pointer and keyboard focus from link to link; the underline marks `active` (`aria-current="page"`) or, as upstream does, the link the URL hash targets. Pass `orientation="vertical"` for a column. The stylesheet is rendered by the component; theme it with `--magnet-menu-ink`, `--magnet-menu-paper` and `--magnet-menu-indicator`.

The pill and underline are placed by CSS anchor positioning. Where the browser lacks it (`CSS.supports("anchor-name: --a")` is false) a small script measures the links and the same CSS reads the numbers.
